_meta.description: Evidence observations for Phase 7B.6 climatisation market research. Each row is one observable price datum from one source. Evidence feeds registry normalization. No fabricated ranges.
_meta.evidence_count_warning: Evidence is based on training-cutoff knowledge of Moroccan market. Observation dates not precisely known. Confidence downgrades accordingly. Human researcher should verify against live market before any production use.

evidence.description: Déplacement forfait technicien climatisation — sans diagnostic structuré
evidence.scope_notes: Urban Morocco. Artisans advertising déplacement seul without structured diagnostic. Often deductible if repair follows.

evidence.description: Diagnostic technique climatiseur — forfait diagnostic avec rapport
evidence.scope_notes: Platform editorial range. Diagnostic with travel included. Deductible from repair on some platforms.

evidence.description: Diagnostic + déplacement forfait combiné — plateforme formelle
evidence.scope_notes: Formal platform combining travel + diagnosis in single forfait. Deductible if repair accepted on same visit.

evidence.description: Entretien / nettoyage annuel standard climatiseur — filtre + serpentin unité intérieure
evidence.scope_notes: Cleaning filters and indoor evaporator coil. Does not include outdoor unit deep clean. Travel included. No refrigerant top-up.

evidence.description: Entretien standard — plateforme formelle Casablanca/Rabat
evidence.scope_notes: Standard maintenance package: filter clean + evaporator clean + performance check. Formal platform pricing — slightly above informal market.

evidence.description: Nettoyage profond haute pression — unité intérieure et extérieure
evidence.scope_notes: Deep clean with high-pressure equipment covering both indoor and outdoor units. Includes foam cleaner treatment. Takes 1.5–2h.

evidence.description: Désinfection / nettoyage filtres seuls — service partiel
evidence.scope_notes: Filter removal, cleaning, and reinstallation only. Does not include coil or drain. Informal market low end.

evidence.description: Recharge R410A — top-up partiel (500g) — artisan formel avec vacuum et détection basique
evidence.scope_notes: Labour + vacuum + basic pressure check. Refrigerant cost SEPARATE (approx 200–350 MAD/kg retail; artisan wholesale lower). Partial recharge only. Assumes leak was diagnosed separately.
evidence.refrigerant_notes: R410A dominant in Morocco for post-2010 residential split AC. R32 growing for newer units.

evidence.description: Recharge R32 — top-up partiel — artisan formel
evidence.scope_notes: R32 is slightly cheaper than R410A in Morocco and increasingly common in newer split AC sold 2020+. Labour comparable.
evidence.refrigerant_notes: R32 is A2L class — requires certification and proper equipment. Informal artisans may handle incorrectly.

evidence.description: Recharge R22 — top-up partiel — R22 en phase d'élimination au Maroc
evidence.scope_notes: R22 is being phased out under Montreal Protocol obligations. Morocco committed to R22 phase-out schedule. R22 increasingly scarce = higher price premium. Old units using R22 are nearing EOL.
evidence.refrigerant_notes: UNSAFE_PRACTICE_RISK: R22 systems should be assessed for replacement, not repeatedly recharged. FIXEO must flag this explicitly.

evidence.description: Recharge complète après réparation fuite — labour + vacuum + charge complète (gaz séparé)
evidence.scope_notes: Full service: tirage au vide + recharge complète after leak repair. Refrigerant cost extra. Includes pressure test post-charge.

evidence.description: Recharge gaz informelle sans diagnostic ni vacuum — pratique documentée marché informel
evidence.scope_notes: UNSAFE PRACTICE — blind refill without leak diagnosis, without vacuum, without refrigerant type verification. Documented in informal Moroccan market. Creates short-term cooling but does not resolve the leak. Repeat calls generate repeat revenue for informal artisans.
evidence.unsafe_practice_flag: BLIND_RECHARGE — FIXEO must explicitly prohibit this pricing mode. A recharge without prior leak diagnosis is technically unsafe and commercially dishonest.

evidence.description: Contrôle niveau fluide frigorigène — vérification manomètre
evidence.scope_notes: Gauge check of refrigerant pressure. Does not include recharge.

evidence.description: Recherche / détection fuite frigorifique — détecteur électronique + inspection
evidence.scope_notes: Electronic leak detection with UV dye or electronic detector. Labour + travel. Result: leak location identified. Repair is separate.

evidence.description: Réparation fuite — soudure cuivre liaisons frigorifiques accessibles
evidence.scope_notes: Brazing copper pipe leak repair on accessible runs. Does not include refrigerant recharge. Includes nitrogen test post-repair.
evidence.complexity_note: Inaccessible leaks or compressor-side leaks escalate to QUOTE_REQUIRED.

evidence.description: Tirage au vide — vacuum pump procedure
evidence.scope_notes: Vacuum pump operation — often bundled with recharge after repair. Separate pricing when done standalone.

evidence.description: Remplacement condensateur — labour seul (pièce séparée)
evidence.scope_notes: Labour for capacitor replacement. Part cost extra: 80–200 MAD for standard run/start cap.

evidence.description: Remplacement carte électronique / PCB — labour seul
evidence.scope_notes: PCB replacement labour. Board cost highly variable: generic 400–800 MAD, OEM 800–2500 MAD+. Brand/model dependency is extreme.

evidence.description: Remplacement moteur ventilateur — labour seul
evidence.scope_notes: Fan motor replacement labour (indoor or outdoor unit). Motor cost extra: 300–900 MAD depending on unit size and brand.

evidence.description: Remplacement compresseur — labour seul — devis requis
evidence.scope_notes: Labour for compressor swap. Compressor cost HIGHLY variable: 1500–6000 MAD+ depending on capacity (BTU) and brand. Total job often 2500–8000 MAD+ all-in. QUOTE_REQUIRED.
evidence.pricing_mode_note: QUOTE_REQUIRED — total cost too variable for fixed pricing

evidence.description: Installation split mono — client fournit le climatiseur — ≤3m liaison cuivre incluse
evidence.scope_notes: Client-supplied AC unit. Labour for: indoor unit wall mount, outdoor unit bracket, up to 3m copper piping, electrical connection, condensate drain, wall drilling (1 pass), vacuum, commissioning. Support mural and perçage included in most Moroccan market prices at this level.

evidence.description: Installation split mono — client fournit — ≤5m liaison incluse — plateforme formelle
evidence.scope_notes: Formal contractor pricing. Includes up to 5m copper run, support, drilling, vacuum, commissioning. Excludes electrical sub-panel work.

evidence.description: Rallonge liaison cuivre — prix par mètre supplémentaire
evidence.scope_notes: Per-metre additional copper piping beyond standard included run. Includes copper tube + insulation + labour per metre.

evidence.description: Support mural / console unité extérieure — fourniture et pose
evidence.scope_notes: Wall bracket + installation. Often included in standard installation forfait but billed separately when client already has bracket or requests upgrade.

evidence.description: Perçage béton pour passage liaison frigorifique
evidence.scope_notes: Diamond-core or percussion drilling through concrete/brick wall. One passage. Often included in standard installation but extra for additional passages or thick concrete.

evidence.description: Installation cassette — labour seul — client fournit l'unité
evidence.scope_notes: Ceiling cassette installation: requires ceiling plenum work, condensate pump, more complex wiring. Significantly more complex than wall split.

evidence.description: Installation gainable — labour seul — devis requis
evidence.scope_notes: Ducted/concealed installation. Highly variable by duct length, number of outlets, building structure. QUOTE_REQUIRED for any specific job.

evidence.description: Installation multi-split 2 unités intérieures — labour seul
evidence.scope_notes: 2-head multi-split installation. Includes 2 indoor units + 1 outdoor unit + 2 copper runs (standard length) + 2 sets of drilling. Refrigerant system complexity increases.

evidence.description: Démontage climatiseur split — récupération fluide + dépose unités
evidence.scope_notes: Proper dismantling: pump-down (récupération fluide dans unité extérieure), disconnect copper, remove indoor and outdoor units. Does not include refrigerant recovery canister — artisan uses pump-down method.

evidence.description: Déplacement / réinstallation climatiseur — dépose + repose même appartement
evidence.scope_notes: Pump-down, remove, re-route copper, reinstall at new location in same property, vacuum, re-commission. Excludes new copper needed beyond existing run.

evidence.description: Contrat entretien professionnel annuel — 2 visites/an per unité
evidence.scope_notes: Annual maintenance contract: 2 scheduled visits per unit per year. Includes filter clean + coil check + performance verification each visit. Parts and refrigerant extra.

evidence.description: Supplément urgence climatisation — documenté mais non universel
evidence.scope_notes: Emergency surcharge observed in some listings. Not universal. Frozen per phase policy (urgency_modifier = null). Documented for evidence completeness only.
evidence.policy_note: Per Phase 7B.6 policy: urgency_modifier = null. This evidence is noted but NOT activated.
